Debes vovler a poner(substituir) el service-worker
<script>
if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
        navigator.serviceWorker
            .register("./service-worker.js")
            .then(() => {
                console.log("✅ Service Worker registrado");
            })
            .catch(error => {
                console.error(error);
            });
    });
}
</script>
